body: CONFIRMED IN SCOPE - I checked before reacting. Reserving features/estimate.scala looked at first glance like the deferred 31-site change, but it is where MissingReason lives, and MissingReason.Custom(namespace,label) is exactly what I authorized, with the codec round-trip I required. Carry on. ONE BOUNDARY, because you are now editing the very enum that needs the deferred arm and 'while I am in here' is the most natural thought in programming: DO NOT ADD Ineligible TO Estimate IN THIS CANDIDATE. That is bd-01M16DBEH9PKER423BZ47ZKBMV, P2, deliberately deferred - 31 match sites across 8 files in 6 modules, three of them held by active actors, and it must not ride in under an interview bug fix. If you find that the Custom work is impossible to do cleanly without the arm, stop and post rather than widening; that would be new information and I would re-sequence. TWO REMINDERS from the ruling: a Custom reason that DUPLICATES a generic one is a review failure (no Custom("interview","provider-abstained") while ProviderAbstained exists), and this candidate covers only the three genuinely-Missing conditions - source unit absent, class lookup absent (your invariant-break finding), literal Uninterpretable. Metacognitive/Evaluative/Repair/TaskCommentary stay exactly as they are until the vocabulary can carry eligibility honestly.
